main_text.p: קטַי Chal. Decurtatus, abbreviatus membro aliquo, Num.11.32.in Jon.Item Intercisus,Non plenus.Plur. תְּרֵין יוֹמִין קְטִיעִין Duo dies intercisi, non integri, Exod. 21.21.in Jonath.

קטַף Ch. Putavit, amputavit, scidit,abscidit,decerpsit,exscidit,succidit:vindemiavit. Sic & Syr. Partic. plur. ܩܛܦܘ Decerpunt, Lucæ 6.44. vel vindemiant. Ithpehal אִתְקְטַף, vel Ithpahel אִתְקְטַף Excindi,succidi,resecari. Ex Aphel Fut. וַיֵּת אַבְהַּ יִקְטֵיף Et fructum ejus succidet,Ezech.17.9.
קְטוּפָא קְטוּף קְטֵף Chal. Vindemiator. Plur. קְטוּפִין Vindemiatores.
קְטָפָא Ch. Vindemia.Cum Aff. וְעַל קְטָפֵךְ Et super vindemiam tuam,Jesa.16.9.
קְטַף Chal. Opobalsamum: vel Theriaca:Resina,Resp. Hebr. צְרִי, & נְטָף.

קטַר Ch. Ligare, alligare, colligare,redimire,Heb. קָשַׁר. Item Fumare,Gen.22.4.in Jon.Ex Pahel Partic. דְּרִיתָא מְקַטְּרָן Atria fumigata, caminata, Hebr. קְטֹרוֹת;Alii,Colligata,conjuncta,Ezec.46.22.Ithpeh. אִתְקַטַּר Ligari, colligari, Syr. ܐܬܩܛܪ Colligatur, connectitur,ad Eph.4.16. Aphel אַקְטַר Adolevit, suffivit,suffumigavit,fumum,suffitum fecit.
קוּטְרָא Ch. Idem, Psal.18.9.& Gen.19.28.in Jon.
קְטְרִין C. Nodi,vincula,ligamina. Syr. ܩܛܪ Act.8.23.
